subject: ApexHealth horizontal expansion — onboarding matrix & crediting for new projects
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: ApexHealth horizontal expansion — onboarding matrix & crediting for new projects

Hi Marta,

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Per our call, ApexHealth is looking to add three additional product teams (Customer Portal, Claims Ingestion, and Clinical Insights) over the next two quarters and we'd like to map out a rollout that minimizes production risk while securing the additional capacity and credits you requested.

Attached is a draft onboarding matrix that lays out:
- Project owners and primary contacts
- API namespace / key segmentation options (single tenant vs namespaced keys)
- Targeted start dates for canary + full rollout
- Estimated committed capacity and suggested reserved pool sizing
- Recommended crediting schedule tied to milestones

High-level asks from our side:
1) Confirm whether you prefer a single API namespace with scoped keys or separate namespaces per product team (we recommended scoped keys to simplify cross-team observability).
2) Approve the canary schedule below so we can reserve Dedicated pool capacity for the first two weeks of each team's activation.

Proposed canary cadence (tentative):
- Customer Portal: start 2028-05-15 (2-week canary)
- Claims Ingestion: start 2028-06-05 (1-week canary)
- Clinical Insights: start 2028-07-02 (2-week canary)

I've included Ben and Priyom on this thread to confirm capacity and crediting mechanics (Ben for quota/commits, Priyom for SOW language). Please flag any procurement contacts I should include and let me know if the dates look feasible.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Attachment: Apex_Onboarding_Matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Marta Lopez <marta@apexhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ApexHealth horizontal expansion — onboarding matrix & crediting for new projects

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — matrix looks useful. Quick answers inline:
- API namespace: prefer separate namespaces per team for clearer billing and role scoping. That said, if scoped keys give better perf/observability, open to a hybrid approach.
- Canary dates: the Customer Portal date works. Claims team wants to push to 6/12 instead of 6/05 (they have a pre-release). Clinical Insights is fine.

Procurement: please include procurement@apexhealth.com on contract/redline threads. They're slow on paperwork but need the SOW and addendum to start approvals.

One other ask: can you confirm the crediting cadence? We had discussed a partial credit at contract signature and the remainder spread across the first two milestone activations. Need that spelled out for our finance team.

Appreciate it — cc'd Procurement below.

-Marta
Marta Lopez
Director, Platform Integrations\ApexHealth
marta@apexhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ApexHealth horizontal expansion — onboarding matrix & crediting for new projects

Hey team,

Couple of operational notes from infra/commits perspective:
- Separate namespaces per team is straightforward. We'll provision three namespaces and attach dedicated API keys. That keeps rate limiting and token-level cost attribution clean.
- For capacity, to support the proposed canaries we recommend the following reserved pools:
  * Customer Portal: 2 x g4dn-equivalent reserved slots (2-week reservation)
  * Claims Ingestion: 1 x g4dn-equivalent (canary), scale to 3 on full rollout
  * Clinical Insights: 2 x g4dn-equivalent (2-week reservation)
- Crediting: we can do a $35k credit at signature, then $25k after the first production activation (Customer Portal successful canary), and remaining $40k after the second production activation (either Claims or Clinical Insights).

A couple of asks from me:
1) If procurement needs us to split the SOW into an addendum that lists per-namespace commits, Priyom can draft that language.
2) We need a short window (48 hours) where Apex confirms traffic is nominal during canary so we can release burst capacity reservations; please build that confirmation into the internal runbook.

If that crediting schedule works for you, I'll ask Legal to start the addendum draft and route to procurement@apexhealth.com.

Ben Carter
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW_addendum_Apex.pdf (PDF, 78KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@apexhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, ApexHealth Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ApexHealth horizontal expansion — onboarding matrix & crediting for new projects

Hi all,

Looping in procurement as requested. Quick SOW/addendum notes below (draft language will follow):
- \"Additional Namespaces & Keying\": Redwood will provision and manage three separate API namespaces associated with ApexHealth under the same master account (namespaces: apex-customer-portal, apex-claims, apex-clinical-insights). Each namespace will have 2 primary keys and a rotation lifecycle set to 90 days.
- \"Reserved Pool Commitments\": Redwood will reserve the capacity listed in the onboarding matrix for the canary windows. Reserved capacity will be billed at the committed rate; credits described below will be applied as account-level adjustments.
- \"Crediting Schedule\": $35,000 credit applied at signature; $25,000 credit applied after successful Customer Portal production activation and 48hr confirmation; $40,000 credit applied after successful second production activation and 48hr confirmation. Credits will show on the next billing cycle after confirmation.
- \"Change Management\": Minor schedule shifts (<= 14 days) handled via email confirmation. Major scope changes will require an updated addendum.

Next steps for procurement: please confirm preferred PO flow (PO -> signed SOW -> invoice) and any internal PO numbers to reference. Once procurement confirms, Legal will circulate the addendum and we can lock in the signature credit.

I'll have a one-page addendum draft to circulate by EOD Monday and a redline-ready SOW by Tuesday morning.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Manager, Solutions Architecture\Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
